profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have a creative spirit and have played a key role in establishing both short-term goals and longer term visions for the product systems developed by a larger team.  I thoroughly enjoy design and problem solving in general and tend to be conspicuously enthusiastic in working to achieve goals that make a difference to customers.  I lead by example and make every effort to inspire the team of people I work with to deliver more than what is expected.

•	More than 15 years managing international cross-functional development teams. 
•	Extensive experience in design and development of sophisticated, mission critical systems using Service Orient Architecture and Agile Methodologies.
•	Excellent communication skills and problem solving abilities. 
•	Expertise in Healthcare Information Technologies, interfacing with EMR/PACS systems, and implementing clinical documentation solutions.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: As an independent contractor, I've designed and developed tools used to compare and contrast health insurance plans. The system is hosted on Azure, built using .NET Core C# and T-SQL. Primary components include a SQL Server database and website implemented using MVC and dependency injection patterns. It features a SharePoint site where documents are published and operated on via Microsoft Graph Rest API.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Microsoft Azure · JavaScript · Microsoft Graph API

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded modernization efforts for a decade-old product transitioning from a data center to the AWS cloud. This included establishing CI/CD pipelines, implementing automated testing, enabling zero-downtime deployments, generating SBOMs, and delivering significant security enhancements.

As a senior engineer, I contributed within a large team tasked with customizing a Medicare enrollment application to meet evolving needs specific to the State of North Carolina. Technologies used included Jira, Teams, Java, Oracle PL/SQL, and Pentaho Data Integration tools. I was one of two engineers administering all AWS accounts utilized by the project team, responsible for implementation and maintaining all development, testing, and production environments assembled using AWS services including EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, and RDS.

Led team into adoption of modern tools such as VSCode and Git Copilot, while introducing advanced techniques like Distributed Ledger Technologies and microservices.

Early in my tenure at Maximus, I designed and implemented internal websites enabling employees to file W-4 tax forms and facilitate charitable payroll deductions. These applications were built using .NET Core 3.1, integrated with a Costpoint Oracle database, MySQL database, third-party web services, and hosted in AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · AWS ECS · AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) · PL/SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a comprehensive revenue assurance platform for telecommunications service providers, including advanced fraud detection tools.

Served as the principal architect and engineer of multithreaded services capable of processing high volumes of ASN.1-encoded call data records at rates up to 5.2×10105.2 \times 10^{10}5.2×1010 per node. 

Designed and developed a .NET Core web application utilizing MVC, dependency injection, and third-party components including Telerik. The platform provided mobile network operators with real-time graphs and analytical tools. Unit tests covering more than 95% of code were developed using NUnit.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · JavaScript · NUnit · SQL · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led engineers on a cross-functional SCRUM team to develop a physician-facing speech recognition product utilizing natural language processing (NLP) services. The product provides real-time feedback on documentation deficiencies or inconsistencies as physicians author medical records.

Coordinated efforts across multiple engineering teams with competing priorities to integrate groundbreaking, life-saving NLP technologies into various clinical documentation products used by physicians.
Directed a globally distributed cross-functional team in creating a documentation tool with integrated speech recognition features, supporting thousands of physicians by leveraging transcription and coding services.

Facilitated the successful migration of transcription platform development to engineering teams based in Europe and India, ensuring a seamless transition.

Technologies, tools, and techniques utilized included: .NET, Asp.NET, C#, Java, SQL, JavaScript, Bootstrap, AngularJS, Spring, MVC, SOA, SOAP Web Services, RESTful Web Services, XML, HL7-CDA, HL7-FHIR, Tomcat, IIS, SQL Server, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Logstash, VMWare, Test-Driven Development, Continuous Integration, Mercurial, Jenkins, ANT, UML, JIRA, Fisheye+Crucible, Confluence, Agile, and SCRUM Methodologies.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Worked with executive teams to establish technical visions and strategies aligned with organizational goals, identifying and mitigating risks to ensure stable and reliable production operations. This included evaluating overlapping systems through multiple company mergers, developing plans and overseeing the execution of all major software engineering initiatives in pursuit of organizational efficiency and consistent customer satisfaction. In this role I supervised 12-15 direct reports, including development leads, DBAs, QA engineers, and project managers.

As the principal architect of a dynamic, high-volume, always growing medical records platform used by hundreds of hospitals and thousands of healthcare information specialists, I set the direction in evolving the system to keep up with increasing load while extending features and capabilities to include then emerging speech recognition technologies. 

Technologies, tools and techniques utilized included .NET NET, Asp.NET, C#, C++, T-SQL, PL/SQL, Enterprise Library, MVC, SOA, WCF Services, SOAP Web Services, WPF (MVVM), HL7-CDA, HL7 V2 & V3, IIS, SQL Server, Oracle 8i, Team Foundation Server, UML, Visio, MS Project, ClearCase, and both Waterfall and Agile methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal designer and lead developer in a multi-year redesign/refactoring of a clinical documentation production platform increasing medical transcriptionist productivity by more than 30% and moving to a XML based document model.  This included design and development of an editor used by thousands of transcriptionists and services transforming the documents before delivering them through hundreds of instances of customer specific interfaces.

Grew and led a team of integration engineers responsible for gathering customer requirements before building and maintaining highly customized interfaces to meet those requirements. Each customer integration required setting up systems to capture physician dictation, an interface to process inbound ADT patient information, and one or more outbound interfaces through which transcribed documents were delivered back to healthcare information systems or facilities by means including: TCPIP, FTP, Print, Fax, and email.

Technologies utilized included C++, PL/SQL, T-SQL, .Net, C#, Com+, C, IIS, Oracle 8i, Sql Server, XML, HL7-V2&V3, SourceSafe.
